description: SECURITY (s441, F5). An `on mount` block declares a helper wrapping a server call and uses it in a `.some` callback. The server answers false for every element, so `.some` MUST be false ("rejected"). Before s441 the mount body only awaited DIRECT server calls in statement positions: the helper was emitted sync and `.some` saw a Promise per element — "accepted" for every input. The helper is now emitted async and the callback lifted to the awaited combinator, exactly as in a function body.
rationale: §13.2: every server call site SHALL be awaited and any function containing one SHALL be async — in an `on mount` block (§6.7.1a) as in a function body (ruling S440 JS-WAT #11).
